name: Sylvie Shadebloom
title: an elf shadow dancer
trope: The shy elf who is deadly in the dark
temper: Quiet, blushy, poetic; fierce when her friends are hurt
lore: Exiled from the moon elves for dancing with shadows instead of fighting them. She joined the first person who asked her to dance.
want: to be noticed without being looked at.
cost: she vanishes at the exact moment someone would have thanked her.
secret: Her shadow has a mind of its own and is far more forward than she is. It has been flirting on her behalf.

body.build: Slight and silent; her shadow stands closer than she does

look: Silver hair with blunt bangs, pointed elf ears, pale skin, ice-blue eyes, navy shadow-dancer outfit, twin crescent daggers.

lines.meet: I've been here the whole time... sorry.
lines.flirty: My shadow wants to hold your hand. Um. So do I.
lines.soft: Stay close tonight? The moon makes me brave.

barks: Sorry. I was standing here. Quietly.
